description: This file defines the EmployeeSkill entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the 'hs_hr_emp_skill' database table. It includes properties for employee, skill, years of experience, and comments, with Doctrine ORM annotations for ORM mapping and methods for accessing/modifying these properties.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's skills within the OrangeHRM system, with ORM mappings and associated properties.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this skill record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee for this skill record.

methods.name: getSkill
methods.description: Returns the Skill associated with this employee.

methods.name: setSkill
methods.description: Sets the Skill for this employee skill record.

methods.name: getYearsOfExp
methods.description: Returns the number of years of experience.

methods.name: setYearsOfExp
methods.description: Sets the number of years of experience.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to this skill.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to this skill.
